title: Senior Business Analyst (m/w/d) - Zahlungsverkehr (Ref.Nr.: 47982)
description:
Für ein langfristiges Projekt bei unserem Kunden in Zürich (Remote-Anteil nur innerhalb der Schweiz möglich) suchen wir einen Senior Business Analyst (m/w/d) - Zahlungsverkehr.

Key Facts
Start: 01.12.2026
Dauer: 13 Monate /
Auslastung: 100 %
Einsatzart:
Einsatzort: Zürich
Einsatzland: Schweiz


Ihre Aufgaben

• Fachliche Anforderungen an eine Notbetriebslösung im Zahlungsverkehr aufnehmen, analysieren, konzipieren und dokumentieren sowie Umsetzungskonzepte erarbeiten

• Fachliche und technische Anforderungen so spezifizieren und zu Epics, Features und Stories ausarbeiten, dass sie als Grundlage für die Umsetzung durch interne IT-Teams und Softwarelieferanten dienen

• Change-Anforderungen von ihrer Entstehung bis zur erfolgreichen Einführung End-to-End begleiten

• Fachliche und technische Anforderungen sowie Prozesse mit Fachbereichen, IT-Teams, externen Partnern, Business Continuity Management und weiteren Projektbeteiligten abstimmen und synchronisieren

• Fachliche Schnittstellenanforderungen und Datenflüsse zwischen den bestehenden Systemen, Datenadaptern und dem Softwarelieferanten abgleichen und definieren

• Sicherstellen, dass die Notbetriebslösung regulatorische Anforderungen erfüllt, Geschäftsprozesse angemessen unterstützt und in das Kernbankensystem integriert wird

• Abnahmetests der fachlichen Anforderungen durchführen sowie die Ergebnisse in die abschliessende Dokumentation und Schulungsunterlagen überführen



Muss-Anforderungen

• Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Betriebswirtschaft oder Wirtschaftsinformatik

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung als Business Analyst, idealerweise im Bankenumfeld

• Kenntnisse im Zahlungsverkehr, insbesondere des ISO-20022-Standards sowie von CAMT- und MX-Meldungen

• Know-how in Confluence und JIRA

• Sehr versiert in der Anforderungsanalyse, Prozessmodellierung und der Erstellung von Fachkonzepten

• Erfahrung in der Spezifikation fachlicher und technischer Anforderungen, einschliesslich Schnittstellenanforderungen, fachlicher Datenmodelle und nicht-funktionaler Anforderungen

• Gutes Verständnis von IT-Systemen und deren Integration

• Starke Kommunikations- und Koordinationsfähigkeiten, insbesondere bei der Abstimmung von Anforderungen mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern, der Projektleitung und weiteren Teams

• Kenntnisse agiler Methoden und Frameworks wie SAFe oder Scrum sowie Erfahrung in der Leitung oder Mitarbeit in komplexen Projekten

• Hohe Eigenverantwortung, Flexibilität, unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln, überzeugendes und sicheres Auftreten, ausgeprägte Dienstleistungsorientierung, Durchsetzungsvermögen, Lernbereitschaft und Teamfähigkeit

• Offene Persönlichkeit mit einer raschen Auffassungsgabe

• Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift



Kann-Anforderungen

• IREB- oder ITIL-Zertifizierung

• Kenntnisse in BCM-Prozessen, idealerweise in Verfahren wie MiniSIC

• Erfahrung in komplexen Projekten, idealerweise in der digitalen Transformation oder im Notfallmanagement



Weitere Informationen

- Einsatzdauer: Dezember 2026 bis Dezember 2027 mit Option auf Verlängerung


- Pensum:100%


- Einsatzort: Zürich & Remote (nur innerhalb der Schweiz möglich) - pro Woche



Let’s power the future together
Vom Business Case bis hin zur Umsetzung: Als führendes Beratungsunternehmen für strategische Transformationen sind wir vertrauenswürdiger Partner für unsere Kunden - und für unsere Mitarbeitenden. Verantwortungsvoll, leistungsstark und immer mit dem Menschen im Fokus. #WeAreWavestone

title: Junior Digital Assets Operations Analyst
description:
Application URL
https://omegadg.com/work/remoteok

Omega Enterprises is an international digital-assets company focused on cryptocurrency markets, market intelligence, and data-based financial operations. We are expanding our team and looking for motivated people who would like to build practical knowledge of digital markets and develop their analytical skills.

This is an entry-level opportunity designed for candidates who are interested in cryptocurrency, financial markets, and working with market information. Previous employment in the crypto industry is not necessary. New team members receive onboarding, training, and ongoing support from experienced colleagues.

What You'll Do

  • Follow daily developments across cryptocurrency and digital-asset markets.
  • Assist the team with routine operational and analytical activities.
  • Track changes in prices, trading activity, liquidity, and other relevant indicators.
  • Gather information from internal and external market-data sources.
  • Maintain organized records and prepare concise internal reports.
  • Summarize market observations for team discussions.
  • Take part in regular training, feedback sessions, and team meetings.
  • Complete structured tasks under the guidance of more experienced team members.

What You'll Get

  • Fully remote working arrangement.
  • Flexible day-to-day workflow.
  • Structured onboarding for people new to the crypto industry.
  • Training in basic market-analysis and digital-asset tools.
  • Access to practical market information and analytical resources.
  • Regular feedback and guidance from a mentor.
  • A clear path for developing toward more advanced analytical responsibilities.
  • Opportunity to work within an international digital-assets team.

The Person We're Looking For

  • Are genuinely interested in cryptocurrency, financial markets, or market analytics.
  • Enjoy learning new tools and working with structured information.
  • Pay attention to detail when handling data and written tasks.
  • Can follow procedures and instructions consistently.
  • Are dependable, organized, and comfortable working independently.
  • Have English proficiency around B2 or higher, sufficient for professional tools, market information, and training materials.

Position Details

  • Position: Junior Digital Assets Operations Analyst
  • Work format: Remote
  • Experience: Entry level / training provided

https://omegadg.com/work/remoteok

title: Revenue Operations Associate
description:
Our Mission

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.

Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben, Abs, Sabrina, and Rebe.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone hungry to learn and early in their career to join us as our Revenue Operations Associate!

You'll get an inside look at, and be a key part of, how a high-performing GTM function operates: this is a great opportunity for exceptionally smart, motivated individuals who want to immerse themselves in the world of tech startups and gain real exposure to what it takes to keep a high-growth business moving.

You'll sit at the intersection of our GTM, Customer and Finance teams, keeping our systems, data, and reporting sharp as we scale. This isn't a "keep the lights on" role – you'll inherit processes that are still being built, and you'll have real room to audit what's working, fix what isn't, and put your own stamp on how we operate.

You'll get broad exposure early: one week you might be untangling a HubSpot workflow, the next you're building a dashboard the CCO takes into a board meeting. It's a genuinely excellent grounding in how a B2B SaaS business scales – but it comes with real pace, longer hours than a typical first job, and a learning curve to match. If you want breadth of exposure and a steep climb early in your career, this is a great seat.

What Can You Expect?

  • Keep our GTM tech stack in good shape: Own day-to-day CRM administration – data hygiene, permissions, and workflow upkeep – and support the configuration and integration of the wider stack.

  • Stay ahead of what's new: Keep across releases and new features across our tools – joining release webinars, reading release notes, and flagging what's worth adopting.

  • Help evaluate and set up new tools: Get involved as we add to the stack, from evaluation through to implementation.

  • Improve our data quality: Spot where data is incomplete or inconsistent, fix what you can, and propose fixes for the rest.

  • Build reporting and dashboards: Turn raw data into dashboards and reports that track pipeline health, funnel conversion, and the other KPIs the GTM team relies on day to day.

  • Support incentive tracking: Help maintain and monitor commission and incentive tracking, making sure calculations are accurate.

  • Onboard new GTM joiners: Train new starters across the GTM and Customer teams on our tools and processes so they're productive quickly.

  • Own our recurring admin cadence: Take ownership of the regular tasks that keep the engine running and look to automate where ever possible.

About You

  • You have a top-class academic record: you'll have graduated with (or be on track for) a 1st class degree, or have attended one of the top universities in the country you studied in – we're looking for a strong, proven track record of academic performance as the clearest early signal of the analytical rigour this role needs.

  • You're curious about how technology fits together: you likely have a STEM background, and you enjoy working out how systems, data, and workflows connect to make a business run – even if you've never worked in RevOps before.

  • You want pace, eyes open: you're drawn to a fast-scaling business precisely because of the pace, and you understand that means longer hours and a steeper learning curve than a typical grad role. You see that as a trade worth making.

  • You're happy to get stuck in: you know not every task here is glamorous – some of it is spreadsheet clean-up, data hygiene, or repetitive admin – and you take real satisfaction in doing that work well, not just the exciting parts.

  • You want to understand how B2B SaaS businesses scale: you're looking to build a first-hand understanding of the GTM engine – pipeline, systems, data, and the commercial mechanics behind it – as a foundation for wherever your career goes next.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!
